vulnerability.name: USN-9201-1
vulnerability.description: Juthawong Naisanguansee discovered that NetworkManager on Ubuntu incorrectly granted the whoopsie user unrestricted D-Bus access to root-only methods. A local attacker who can execute code as the whoopsie user could possibly use this issue to disrupt system networking or alter NetworkManager logging and connection configurations.

statements.status_notes: NetworkManager could allow unintended changes to network configuration.
